note: P8-0 readiness matrix, audited against live source on the Phase 8 base commit. Every Master Architecture §18.2 mature middle-end capability has exactly one state. UNKNOWN is not an allowed state: an unresolved item is an explicit audit task or UPSTREAM_BLOCKED with an owner (PHASE8_FAST_PATH §3).

capabilities.title: Semantic IR v2
capabilities.finding: Canonical constructors exist and are the production default. Phase 8 consumes them; it must not add a second lifting path.

capabilities.title: Semantic CFG, dominance, reverse post-order
capabilities.finding: createSemanticCfg, analyzeSemanticDominance, reversePostOrder and typed edge kinds are all present. P8-5 structuring consumes these; it must not build a second CFG.

capabilities.title: SSA construction and queries
capabilities.finding: Phi definitions, per-predecessor incoming values and use/def indices are queryable. Executable-edge-aware SCCP (P8-2) has the inputs it needs.

capabilities.title: MemorySSA
capabilities.finding: reachingMemoryDefinition, reachingConcreteStore, memoryVersionAtBlock and explainMemoryPath exist. P8-3 load reuse is gated on these rather than on address heuristics.

capabilities.title: Alias and points-to analysis
capabilities.finding: Phase 7 published a conservative alias surface through createAnalysisSurface. Unknown locations stay MayAlias; the migration guardrail enforces it.

capabilities.title: Escape analysis
capabilities.finding: Available through the Phase 7 analysis surface.

capabilities.title: Function summaries and machine effects
capabilities.finding: Interprocedural summaries and the machine-effect model (including intrinsic completeness and fault/control effects) exist. P8-3 effect-aware DCE consumes them; it must not keep a private pure-call whitelist.

capabilities.title: Range and value-set facts
capabilities.finding: A width- and signedness-aware interval domain with merge exists, but there is no wraparound-correct value set, no widening/precision-loss reporting, and no SCCP lattice on top of it. P8-2 extends this domain rather than replacing it.

capabilities.title: Type constraints and type graph
capabilities.finding: Phase 7 truth. P8-6 consumes it; a contradiction stays a contradiction.

capabilities.title: Debug and runtime metadata providers
capabilities.finding: DWARF and PDB providers are identity-bound and fail closed on mismatch.

capabilities.title: Origin sets and transform records
capabilities.finding: createOriginSet, mergeOriginSets and appendTransform exist, and printed lines already carry address/row source. The Phase 8 pass contract requires targets and proof on every transform record.

capabilities.title: Decompiler pass execution
capabilities.finding: PassManager runs an ordered list under one global deadline and merges each pass's return value into shared state as it goes. There is no staged publication, no consumes/preserves/invalidates declaration, and stage order is the array order. P8-1 adds the transaction; P8-0 already keeps the Phase 8 stage outside this deadline so a no-op stage cannot change the rewrite fixed point.

capabilities.title: Expression rewrite engine
capabilities.finding: Named phases, preconditions, proof records, deterministic structural keys and multiple budgets already exist and must be reused rather than duplicated. Defect found at P8-0: the fixed point was bounded by an 18 ms wall clock, so the same input reached different fixed points on different runs. P8-0 added an opt-in work-bounded mode so quality can be measured at all; making the production degradation itself deterministic is P8-1's `transformDeterminismFailureCount = 0` work.

capabilities.title: Loop structuring and repair
capabilities.finding: Canonical post-test loop repair exists and js/controlflow.js already refuses to absorb side-entry nodes into a region. There are no reusable loop facts; P8-4 produces one summary artifact instead of each consumer rediscovering loops.

capabilities.title: Switch recovery
capabilities.finding: Present and regression-tested. P8-5 improves break/continue and default handling on top of it.

capabilities.title: Expression equivalence evaluation
capabilities.finding: Concrete evaluation over exact-width integers exists and compiler-truth uses it as a differential oracle. It is evaluation, not proof; solver-backed proof stays Phase 9 scope.

capabilities.title: ArtifactStore identity and invalidation
capabilities.finding: createArtifactDescriptor keys on producer version, upstream artifact ids and explicit key extras. Phase 8 declares its kinds through it in js/decompiler/phase8/artifact-identity.js and proves the key discriminates.

capabilities.title: Cancellation and deadline behaviour
capabilities.finding: Deadline and shouldAbort exist, but a cancelled pass's partial state is still merged into the shared state. The Phase 8 vertical already withholds its whole ledger on cancellation; P8-1 generalises that to staged mutation.

capabilities.title: Compiler-truth differential
capabilities.finding: Real clang output at six optimization levels, checked against concrete semantic truth. Required Phase 8 gate.

capabilities.title: Ghidra differential
capabilities.finding: A permanent workflow exists. Ghidra is not installed in the development container, so the differential is a CI-side gate; a local run reports unavailable rather than green.

capabilities.title: Cross-binary accuracy
capabilities.finding: Requires fetched real fixtures; not present in the development container, so it is a CI-side gate for Phase 8.

capabilities.title: Architecture-neutrality enforcement
capabilities.finding: Existing gates cover the semantic core. Phase 8 adds a boundary scan over its own generic sources in tools/validation/phase8/metrics.mjs.

capabilities.title: Copy propagation
capabilities.finding: No copy-propagation pass exists. The expression builder inlines single-use definitions during rendering, which is not the same fact and is not reusable by other passes.

capabilities.title: Sparse conditional constant propagation
capabilities.finding: Absent. No executable-edge lattice, no phi handling restricted to executable predecessors. This is the first Phase 8 algorithm lane.

capabilities.title: Global value numbering and CSE
capabilities.finding: Absent. structuralKey in js/decompiler/ast/nodes.js is a rendering-level key and must not be reused as a semantic value number.

capabilities.title: Alias-proven load/store forwarding
capabilities.finding: P8-3 implemented memory-proof-gated load reuse and it is correct, but it cannot fire on any binary today. Reusing a load requires proof that re-executing it is unobservable: ordinary memory, not atomic, no ordering. Address space and ordering are available; atomicity is not. js/targets/architecture/arm64/effects/memory.js sets `atomic = BASE_ONLY.has(mnemonic) ? true : null` for single-transfer accesses, so an ordinary LDR reports `unknown` rather than `false` — a fact the decoder holds and discards. tests/machine-effects/arm64-memory-addressing.test.mjs asserts that behaviour deliberately ('ordinary LDR atomicity is not inferred'), so this is an accepted contract decision and not an oversight for Phase 8 to overturn on its own. All 59 corpus loads are blocked by exactly this. Phase 8 deliberately does NOT require proof that an access is non-volatile: `volatile` is a source annotation and is not recoverable from a stripped binary, so requiring it would make the capability unreachable forever rather than until one upstream fact lands. Unblocking is a one-line change in the owning lane plus re-verification of machine-effects and Phase 6/7 evidence.

capabilities.title: Effect-aware dead code elimination
capabilities.finding: Absent. The effect model needed to separate 'result unused' from 'execution unobservable' already exists in js/semantics/effects and Phase 7 summaries.

capabilities.title: Loop induction facts
capabilities.finding: recoverInductionVariables exists but is a rendering-time helper, not a versioned reusable summary with init/step/guard/bound/signedness/wrap/exit evidence. P8-4 replaces the helper's role with one artifact so aggregate recovery does not rediscover induction.

capabilities.title: Function prototype recovery
capabilities.finding: Exists and is exercised by the corpus. Re-audit for residual ABI assumptions is folded into P8-6/P8-7 rather than being a separate lane.

capabilities.title: High variable recovery and coalescing
capabilities.finding: Exists. P8-6 integrates aggregate candidates with it rather than creating a second variable model.

capabilities.title: Tail-call and thunk normalization
capabilities.finding: Thunk and tail-call handling exists at function discovery, which is where it belongs. No Phase 8 exit gate depends on a decompiler-side normalization, so it is explicitly out of scope rather than silently omitted.

capabilities.title: Irreducible and exception-aware structuring
capabilities.finding: Region building already refuses side entries, and unwind information is parsed by the loaders. There is no edge-accounting verifier and no explicit goto fallback contract, so `lostCfgEdgeCount` is currently not measurable — it is reported as null, never as zero.

capabilities.title: Aggregate, array and union recovery
capabilities.finding: Conservative layout recovery exists and produces layouts on the corpus. It has no contradiction model, no struct/array/union ambiguity preservation and no stride evidence, so `forcedTypeContradictionCount` is currently not measurable.

capabilities.title: Language and compiler refinement providers
capabilities.finding: Compiler and runtime idioms exist but are called directly from the pipeline rather than through a versioned provider interface with recorded provenance and conflict rules.

capabilities.title: x86-64 Phase 8 evidence lane
capabilities.finding: Live capability truth reports x86-64 CFG/Semantic IR, SSA/MemorySSA and shared decompiler as supported, so it is a mandatory Phase 8 lane. The P8-0 corpus reaches the product through an AArch64 assembler harness and therefore does not yet cover it. P8-2 adds architecture-neutral Semantic IR fixtures for the cross-architecture lanes; until then the verifier reports the lane as missing evidence, not as passing.

capabilities.title: RISC-V64 Phase 8 evidence lane
capabilities.finding: Same position as x86-64: mandatory by live capability truth, not yet covered by the P8-0 corpus, reported as missing evidence rather than skipped.

capabilities.title: Solver-backed transform proof
capabilities.finding: Explicitly Phase 9 scope. Phase 8 records transform proofs in a shape a future solver can consume, and does not implement one.
